newsitem.title: USA: Manufactured Home revises Chateau offer.
newsitem.headline: Manufactured Home revises Chateau offer.

text.p: Manufactured Home Communities Inc said Thursday it remains committed to acquiring Chateau Properties Inc and revised the terms of its offer.
The revised proposal offers Chateau shareholders and Operating Partnership Unit holders $26 cash or a convertible preferred security.
The convertible preferred security offers OP unit holders long term tax deferral, higher current income, and other benefits, Manufactured Home said in a statement.
The convertible preferred security is valued at $26 by J.P.Morgan Securities Inc, its financial advisor.
In addition to restructuring the proposal, Manufactured Home said it terminated its tender offer for Chateau common stock and withdrew its request for a preliminary injunction hearing.
The terms for common holders remains the same, a company spokesman said. The value to OP unit holders under revised terms was raised to $26 from $22.57.

"MHC's revised proposal creates an opportunity for all parties to benefit from their association with the dominant owner and operator in the industry...," said Sam Zell, Manufactured Home chairman, in a statement.

Zell said that a proposed merger of Chateau and ROC Communities Inc faces significant obstacles and that Manufactured Home's offer is the best alternative for Chateau shareholders and OP unit holders.
Manufactured Home, a real estate investment trust, is the largest owner and operator of manufactured housing communities in the United States.
